name: com.alimm.tanx.core.ad.ad.template.rendering.reward.RewardVideoPortraitActivity
description: Tanx Core SDK opens this portrait Activity to play a rewarded video and its ad content. When playback reaches the completion point, it reports the reward to the app.
disableEffect: The Tanx rewarded-video screen will not open, so rewards for watching ads will no longer be granted.
